checks: Twelve unique authored maps, three themes, four crop cycles and public deterministic weather
Plant and end-day previews are pure; exact coin and action costs are disclosed
Stale confirmation and occupied plot cannot duplicate seed or action charges
Water caps at two and duplicate watering never consumes another action
Zero cash and exhausted actions reject unaffordable or extra plants without negatives
Null, unknown, prototype crop IDs, fractions and out-of-range plots are refused unchanged
Starting and previewing never grow plants or generate warehouse stock
Only an explicit end-day grows; daylight consumes one water and replenishes only actions
Rain automatically fills water then consumes exactly one for growth; no watering charge
Dry crops stall and remain accounted for; subsequent rain resumes the same plant
Cold stops non-hardy crops while retaining water; watered frost-grain still grows
Unripe harvest, empty watering and empty harvest refuse all mutations
Harvest creates exact uniquely identified units once and frees the plot without income
Replanting the same plot uses a fresh seed fee and batch ID; old inventory persists
Incomplete mixed orders reject atomically without partial stock loss or payment
A delivered order debits exact units, credits once and cannot reuse cargo in a second order
Future orders stay closed and no unknown order can consume resources
Mature crops stop growing, keep their plot and inventory does not appear before harvest
The last permitted day can harvest and deliver a genuine crop and win immediately
A genuine exact-deadline delivery is accepted before day-end
An unfulfilled due order fails on its actual deadline, with a single settlement
Unfulfilled final day ends naturally even with unused funds and cannot run extra turns
Pause blocks planting, growth, harvest and delivery and resume changes no model resources
Ready and in-progress checkpoints store only ordinary commands; exact restore starts paused
Illegal checkpoint commands are rejected; forged resource fields are ignored
Snapshot and checkpoint copies cannot mutate production cash, plot or action history
All twelve normal-budget strategies reproduce exact plants, crops, inventory, orders and ledger
Action totals equal each confirmed farm operation and end-day does not charge or invent coins
fixture: All money, plants, warehouse units, dates, deadline and final-day boundaries use production levels and ordinary actions. No resource or victory-state fixtures.
